citation: Ayalew H, Tsang PW, Chu C, Wang J, Liu S, Chen C, Ma X, Bai G. Comparison of TaqMan, KASP and rhAmp SNP genotyping platforms in hexaploid wheat
what_it_anchors: TaqMan 5'-nuclease PLATFORM performance on a 50-SNP wheat panel (link-level, not per-mismatch)
claim: Design success 39/50 TaqMan vs 49/50 KASP and rhAmp; 30 assays manufactured, one failed on all platforms; 2,784 data points = 96 x 29; TaqMan amplified 93% (7% unamplified), call quality 0.98, KASP-TaqMan concordance 82.17%, rhAmp-TaqMan 90.36%; TaqMan separation angle 0.35 rad (largest) but worst discrimination by the authors

citation: Endo T, Fujii H, Yoshioka T, Omura M, Shimada T. TaqMan-MGB SNP genotyping assay to identify 48 citrus cultivars distributed in the Japanese market
what_it_anchors: TaqMan-MGB probe/SNP composition and a complete 48 x 8 plant call matrix
claim: 8 TaqMan-MGB sets, probes 13-20 nt, allele base never central (centrality 0.73-0.95); 384/384 calls made on 48 cultivars; all amplicons 60-99 bp

citation: David VA, Binns-Roemer E, Winkler CA. Taqman Assay for Genotyping CKD-Associated APOL1 SNP rs60910145: A Cautionary Note
